subject.title: [Bug]: Slack multi-workspace: outbound works on second workspace but inbound DM replies never reach OpenClaw

question: Should maintainers require live two-workspace Slack Socket Mode proof or redacted gateway logs before assigning a fix PR for this issue?
rationale: The report is credible and current source points to a narrow Slack account/routing area, but source inspection does not isolate the failing layer and adjacent fixes are not enough to prove the issue fixed or repairable automatically.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Ask for redacted logs or run a two-workspace Slack Socket Mode check before opening a code fix so the patch targets the actual drop point.

options.title: Sponsor diagnostic investigation
options.body: A maintainer can choose to investigate directly in the Slack plugin, but the first pass should be diagnostic or test-backed rather than assuming a root cause.

options.title: Close only after passing live check
options.body: If current main or a release passes the exact secondary-workspace DM reply flow, close with the commit or release proof.

recommendation.title: Require live repro first
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted logs or run a two-workspace Slack Socket Mode check before opening a code fix so the patch targets the actual drop point.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest feature-history signal for Slack multi-account routing and recent Slack account/monitor ownership.
